Package com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.ai

Class PassiveAI

java.lang.Object
com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.ai.EntityAI
com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.ai.PassiveAI
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.bukkit.event.Listener
public class PassiveAI extends EntityAI
Passive AI implementation.

Entities with this AI are non-aggressive. When a player comes within fleeRange blocks the entity runs directly away from them. Once the threat is out of range the entity stops moving.

    • fleeFromNearbyPlayers

      public void fleeFromNearbyPlayers()
      Finds the nearest threatening player and flees directly away from them. If no player is within flee range, the entity's horizontal velocity is zeroed so it doesn't keep drifting.
